bloomSourceTrace.basis: Source comparison only; not generated, compiled or visually verified
findings: RGB16F intermediate rounding occurs after extraction and each blur.
Extraction uses linear source/depth sampling; blur uses nearest intermediates; combine linearly samples final blur.
Threshold, sky factor, edge-expanded radius, gaussian weights, time dithering, clamp and strength match the shipped formulas for finite nonnegative color inputs.
Intermediate dimensions now derive from scene input dimensions at one-quarter scale, separately from the shader resolution used by blur math.
remaining: Visual/runtime parity, half-precision behavior and resolution changes need validation.
Negative HDR input powers differ intentionally from undefined GLSL pow behavior because CUDA clamps to zero.
